name: Four Seasons Puerto Rico
insider_take: This oceanfront oasis sits on a pristine stretch of Culebra Beach where bioluminescent plankton occasionally light up the waves at night, creating nature's own light show.
whats_special: The hotel occupies a former coconut plantation and features the largest resort pool in Puerto Rico. It's also one of the few luxury resorts where you can witness both sunrise and sunset from different vantage points due to the island's unique geographic positioning.
pro_tip: Book a room on floors 4-6 for unobstructed ocean views and the best chance to spot the rare Puerto Rican parrot, which nests in the nearby El Yunque rainforest area.
dont_miss: The hotel's signature rum tasting featuring locally-distilled spirits, and a morning walk to the nearby Laguna Grande where kayaking through mangrove channels leads to a magical bioluminescent bay experience after dark.
pros: Prime beachfront location in San Juan with pristine sandy beaches
Legendary Four Seasons service and hospitality standards
No passport required for US citizens traveling to Puerto Rico
Multiple dining venues featuring local Caribbean and international cuisine
cons: Premium pricing typical of luxury Four Seasons properties
Hurricane season considerations during summer and fall months
